description: All nine registrations name vibe-ops directly — the plugin ships no script (project/rfc/0005-*.md §5). harness-status (vibe-ops hook harness-status) reads the version of each record type promulgated into the repository being opened and says nothing unless the installed templates are newer; it is passed ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} explicitly because that is where the installed versions are read from, and it reports without ever writing (RFC-0002 open question 1). prefer-mcp (vibe-ops hook prefer-mcp) is TEMPORARY and never decides anything: it names the MCP tool equivalent to a vibe-ops command just run through Bash, and is deleted once the migration it exists for is done. plan-context (vibe-ops hook plan-context) places this repository's plan format and next plan number at the moment a plan is written in plan mode. plan-file (vibe-ops hook plan-file) files an approved plan-mode plan into that repository's project/plans/ and says where it landed. new-context (vibe-ops hook new-context) resolves the repository before a typed /vibe-ops:new starts. task-guard (vibe-ops hook task-guard) refuses to delete a task dossier whose closure ceremony has not run. plan-progress (vibe-ops hook plan-progress) notices a turn wrote to a repository whose plan is active without touching that plan's living sections; it is passed --state-dir ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} because that is where its per-session bookkeeping lives, for the same reason harness-status is passed --plugin. session-cleanup (vibe-ops hook session-cleanup) deletes this session's own state files at SessionEnd, passed the same --state-dir.
